description: Cloning a shared workspace from Home: the user enters a remote URL, picks a folder, and the clone opens. The remote is a local bare repo, so no network or sign-in is needed.

setup.name: Create a project shared through a local bare remote, plus an empty clone destination

beforeEach.name: Drop pending autosaves and per-test UI state
Restore the seeded project, remote, recents and clone destination
Reload the restored project with clean UI state

tests.name: clones a workspace from a remote URL
tests.fixme: AR-40: fill does not expand ${CUTREADY_REMOTE_URL}, so the app receives the literal placeholder

steps.name: the clone has the shared files and history
args: const fs = require('fs'); const dirs = fs.readdirSync('.').filter((d) => d.endsWith('-remote')); if (dirs.length !== 1 || !fs.existsSync(dirs[0] + '/plan.md') || !fs.existsSync(dirs[0] + '/.git')) { console.error('expected one clone with plan.md and .git, found ' + fs.readdirSync('.').join(', ')); process.exit(1); }

steps.name: the clone is now the most recent workspace

tests.name: cancelling the clone folder picker clones nothing

steps.name: nothing was cloned
args: const fs = require('fs'); const dirs = fs.readdirSync('.').filter((d) => d.endsWith('-remote')); if (dirs.length) { console.error('unexpected clone: ' + dirs.join(', ')); process.exit(1); }
